reviews.title: Overpriced but neat.
reviews.comment: The case is real pretty and pretty pleasent to work in but definitely a stretch to charge $190. The cable clips built in are too flimsy to hold cables in the corner, no clips other than those in the corners. Of the 2 fans that come with the case 1 was broken on arrival and the other is just a low quality fan. My gpu (radeon 7800) is big enough to require taking out 1 panel, but then the provided support bracket doesnt even screw into a position that can hold the gpu, even though the bracket does widen enough, the screw placement is the issue (unless it is my micro-atx mobo but it looks like it would be the same placement with a full atx). All the screws are just haphazardly thrown into bags together instead of seperated and labeled at all. Install guide is complete garbage that SOMEBODY could have put at least a bit of effort into helping first time builders. Open spaces around the psu in back of case, letting in who knows how much dust. Have to akwardly bend your hdmi, dp, and usb cables to fit into the mobo and gpu slots before putting the top of the case back on (also causing my 2nd monitor to barely reach). (Clips actually next to the fan mounts would be great for holding loose hanging daisy chains). Between the busted cheap fans and the support bracket not fitting i of course emailed thermaltake support about warranty and have not heard back days later. Best buy support in the app assured me I could go to my local store and have them at least replace the fans with the same model (the store did NOT). Pretty mad I payed so much for this, but I also hope I never need to replace it.
reviews.author: DominicA
